source_concerns.concern: -20°C is -4°F; p11 prints the same range as -20~45°C (-4~113°F). Kept as printed.

source_concerns.printed: (LCD legend) ⑥ バッテリー残量警告灯 / ⑦ バッテリーレベルパーセントタグ
source_concerns.concern: Legend items are laid out in three columns that do not follow numeric order (①②⑤ / ③④⑥ …); Web lists them ①–⑰ in numeric order with the printed wording.

source_concerns.printed: グリーンエネルギー優先モード:本製品は…ソーラーパネルとACアダプターを使って同時に充電できます。
source_concerns.concern: The in-box list (p11) and charging section name an AC充電ケーブル, not an ACアダプター; similar ACアダプター wording appears on p6, p8 and p10/p11. Kept as printed.

source_concerns.printed: 本製品の充電に24Vを使用しないでください。
source_concerns.concern: Probably means a 24V vehicle (24Vの車); kept as printed.

source_concerns.printed: 火のそばや炎天下の車内、熱器具の周辺など高温（40°C以上）になる場所
source_concerns.concern: This edition prints 40°C, whereas the specification lists charging/operating up to 45 °C (JE-1000D JP prints 45°C here). Kept as printed.

source_concerns.printed: お客様の故意または過失\n誤用・誤動作・その他の異常な条件下
source_concerns.concern: Line break after 過失 with no separator between 過失 and 誤用 (JE-1000D JP runs them together as 過失誤用). Kept as printed with the line break.

source_concerns.printed: CPAP（シーパップ） 、スペースシャトルの製造
source_concerns.concern: A visible gap before 、 after the closing parenthesis; kept as a space.

source_concerns.concern: 下記 is printed in a lighter grey than the rest of the line (likely a leftover edit mark in the artwork). Text kept; tone not carried.

source_concerns.printed: 備考：電源を入れた後、アプリが5分以内接続されていないと
source_concerns.concern: 5分 here and in 4.2 (p14); other JE JP editions print 2時間. Kept as printed (model-specific value to confirm).

normalizations: Outlined PDF: original.pdf has no text layer; every Japanese line is a manual transcription from 300 dpi renders (500 dpi clips for small or ambiguous glyphs), kept as printed (source/intake.py names the physical page of each block). No Japanese wording, punctuation or spelling is changed; suspected source errors are listed in source_manifest.json:source_concerns.
Shared Manual IR: content.json is replayed through the shared flow renderer and shared components. No package class or inline style (prepared-document shared-style gate).
Print weights: bold print runs stay strong. Printed bullet (・/●/■) and number marks become lists; nested marks nest under their item. Subscripts stay subscript.
Line ends inside a paragraph are wraps; the print's explicit line breaks inside one block stay line breaks.

Figures are source panels cropped just inside the print's panel frame (the decorative frame is drawn by the shared theme); Japanese words drawn in the art stay in the art and the alt text carries them. Notes and cautions the print boxes inside a panel are shared callout strips under the figure.

Pictogram warning grids (警告/注意): each printed row becomes a shared warning/caution callout with the print's bold title and body; the row pictograms are not repeated per row (JE-1000D JP V2 precedent), their meanings are carried by the shared symbol table.
Cover and table of contents are not Web content (operator decision for this batch).
